_meta.suite: FBS v1.0 (evals/suite/, committed: 100 tasks, 3 tiers, categories A-J)

modes.FAB_MEMORY: FAB + the task's committed memory_snapshot (shipped lesson log as fallback) injected as recalled fabius-archivum memory

_meta.scoring: 7 dimensions x 0-4 (/28) by two blind judges (opus + fable, averaged) + fixed factual checks (3-6 per task) interpreted from answer text by a model grader; mean output chars as the deterministic waste metric
_meta.method_note: A provider session-limit window interrupted judge/grade calls mid-run; every generation completed and was recovered verbatim from the run journals, and only the missing judge/grade calls were re-issued with byte-identical prompts (healer). Cells judged by a single judge are marked via n_judges in perTask.
